update.usage:
crew update check [--force]
  crew update apply
  crew update cleanup [--dry-run]
update.stepFailed: A command failed; nothing else was run. The output above says why.
update.noNewRoot: The update ran, but the updated plugin folder was not found, so the board was not restarted.
update.restartFailed: The updated board did not start in time. The old board keeps running; start the new one with `crew board start`.
update.internal: The update stopped because of an internal error.
update.disabled: Update check is off. Set updates.check to true in the global config to turn it on.
update.unknown: crewgate {current}. No release information yet (the check has not succeeded).
update.staleUpToDate: crewgate {current} was the latest release on {date}, but the last check failed ({error}), so a newer one may exist.
update.rehook: Codex asks you to re-approve the hooks after this update (/hooks).
update.howTo: Run `crew update apply`, or click Update now on the board.
update.manualIntro: Run these commands yourself in a terminal:
update.newSession: Start a new Claude Code / Codex session for the new hooks to apply.
update.boardRestarted: The board was restarted from the updated code.
update.boardRestartFailed: The board did not restart. Start it with `{cmd}`.
update.reason.devCheckout: development checkout, nothing is run automatically
update.oldVersions: {count} old version(s) ({mb} MB) can be removed after you restart your Claude Code / Codex sessions.
update.cleanupHow: Remove them with `crew update cleanup` (add --dry-run to only list them).
update.kept.inUse: Kept {tool} {version}: in use (close your sessions and try again)
update.kept.outside: Kept {tool} {version}: not inside the plugin cache
